messages:
maria: Quick sync 1 fixing semantics for absent vs empty attrs in the obs envelope (billing_key, tenant_id). Getting inconsistent SDK behavior.
kevin: We should prefer omission to keep payload small but need deterministic billing routing. Missing vs empty changes downstream.
sara: Proposal: enrich missing billing_key at ingest, mark provenance. That keeps SDK ergonomics and preserves downstream determinism.
tomas: Agreed but enrichment must be idempotent and deterministic (tenant canonicalization, resolver version).
maria: Add schema_version to envelope so behavior is explicit. Ingest adapters can check schema and apply enrichment rules.
ingest-bot: feature-flag created: ingest.enrichment.infer_billing_key (default off).
kevin: Metrics: ingest.enrichment.attempts, ingest.enrichment.inferred_count, ingest.enrichment.confidence_bucket. Dashboard needed.
sara: For compliance, store original raw diff only when enrichment alters billing attribution (7-day retention). Limits cost.
maria: Action items: I'll draft RFC + proto diff (schema_version + optional provenance); kevin: cost calc for provenance payload & raw diffs; sara: enrichment heuristics; tomas: prototype adapter. Demo next Wed. :thumbsup:
